result.topic_en: Riemann transforms a product of two integrals of the form $\int_0^\infty e^{\mp \pi i x^2(?)}x^{\alpha\mp ti}/(e^{x\sqrt\pi}-e^{-x\sqrt\pi})\,dx$ by the substitution $x=r(1+z)$, $y=r(1-z)$, then expands the denominators into exponentials and evaluates Gaussian integrals over $r$ (with $\varepsilon=e^{\pi i/4}$, $m,n$ integers).
result.transcription:
$\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-xxi} x^{\alpha-ti}\,\partial x}{e^{x\sqrt\pi}-e^{-x\sqrt\pi}} \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{yyi} y^{\alpha+ti}\,\partial y}{e^{y\sqrt\pi}-e^{-y\sqrt\pi}} = 2\int_{-1}^{1}\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-4zrri} r^{1+2\alpha} [-(1+z)-] (1+z)^{\alpha-ti}(1-z)^{\alpha+ti}\,\partial r\,\partial z}{(e^{(1+z)r\sqrt\pi}-e^{-(1+z)r\sqrt\pi})(e^{(1-z)r\sqrt\pi}-e^{-(1-z)r\sqrt\pi})}$
$x=r(1+z)\quad y=r(1-z)\quad \frac{\partial x}{\partial r}\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}\frac{\partial x}{\partial z}=-2r$
$=\int_{-1}^{1}\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-rr} r^{1+2\alpha}\partial r\; z^{[-1-]+\alpha} (1+z)^{\alpha-ti}(1-z)^{\alpha+ti}\,\partial z}{\left(e^{\frac{\sqrt z+\frac{1}{\sqrt z}}{2\varepsilon} r\sqrt\pi}-e^{-\frac{\sqrt z+\frac{1}{\sqrt z}}{2\varepsilon}r\sqrt\pi}\right)\left(e^{\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt z}-\sqrt z}{2\varepsilon}r\sqrt\pi}-e^{\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt z}-\sqrt z}{2\varepsilon}r\sqrt\pi}\right)}\qquad \varepsilon=e^{\frac{\pi}{4}i}$

[-$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-rr+(2m+1)\frac{\sqrt z+\frac{1}{\sqrt z}}{2\varepsilon}r\sqrt\pi+(2n+1)\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt z}-\sqrt z}{2\varepsilon}r\sqrt\pi}\,\partial r$-]\quad m, n ganze Zahlen [?]
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-\left(r-\left((m+n)\sqrt z+(m-n)\frac{1}{\sqrt z}\right)\frac{\sqrt\pi}{4\varepsilon}\right)^2}\partial r\quad e^{\frac{\pi i}{16}\left((m-n)^2 z+2(m^2-n^2)+(m+n)^2\frac{1}{z}\right)}$

methods.what: Change of variables x=r(1+z), y=r(1-z) in a double integral with Jacobian -2r
methods.quote: $x=r(1+z)\quad y=r(1-z)\quad \frac{\partial x}{\partial r}\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}\frac{\partial x}{\partial z}=-2r$

methods.what: Rewriting the product of the two integrals as a double integral over r and z
Expansion of denominators into exponential series with integers m,n and completing the square to get Gaussian integrals in r with a residual exponential factor
methods.quote: $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-\left(r-\left((m+n)\sqrt z+(m-n)\frac{1}{\sqrt z}\right)\frac{\sqrt\pi}{4\varepsilon}\right)^2}\partial r\quad e^{\frac{\pi i}{16}\left((m-n)^2 z+2(m^2-n^2)+(m+n)^2\frac{1}{z}\right)}$
